ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #15 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the short line ـ used for in Arabic letter tables? (1 mark)
   A. It is a vowel
   B. It is a full stop
   C. It shows where a letter joins to another
   D. It is a dot

2. What is the name of the Arabic letter ث? (1 mark)
   A. thaa
   B. haa
   C. DHaa
   D. Saad

3. What sits on the baseline in Arabic writing? (1 mark)
   A. Nothing
   B. Only the dots
   C. Most of the letters
   D. Only the vowels

4. Which family word is written أُخْتٌ? (1 mark)
   A. akh (brother)
   B. ukht (sister)
   C. umm (mother)
   D. ab (father)

5. What does the Arabic word ابْنٌ (ibn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. brother
   B. son
   C. sister
   D. grandmother

6. What does the Arabic word خِزَانَةٌ (khizaana) mean? (1 mark)
   A. book
   B. bed
   C. pen
   D. cupboard

7. What does the Arabic sentence الْبَابُ كَبِيرٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The table is small.
   B. The window is clean.
   C. The door is big.
   D. The chair is new.

8. What is a dictation? (1 mark)
   A. You draw a picture
   B. You sing a song
   C. You copy from the board only
   D. The teacher says a word and you write it

9. What does the Arabic word الثُّلَاثَاءُ (ath-thulaathaa') mean? (1 mark)
   A. Wednesday
   B. Tuesday
   C. Monday
   D. Thursday

10. What does the Arabic word عَصِيرٌ (ʿasiir) mean? (1 mark)
   A. candle
   B. juice
   C. no
   D. your turn

11. What does the Arabic sentence أَنَا أُحِبُّ الْحَفْلَةَ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I have a gift.
   B. I like the party.
   C. We dance.
   D. My mother cooks the food.

12. What does the Arabic sentence أَشْرَبُ الشَّايَ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I drink tea.
   B. The water is clean.
   C. I eat rice.
   D. The banana is delicious.

13. What does the Arabic word سُكَّرٌ (sukkar) mean? (1 mark)
   A. carrots
   B. milk
   C. sugar
   D. bread

14. Which Arabic word means "face"? (1 mark)
   A. رَأْسٌ
   B. وَجْهٌ
   C. أُذُنٌ
   D. لِسَانٌ

15. What does aghsilu wajhii mean? (1 mark)
   A. I clean my teeth.
   B. I write with my hand.
   C. My head is big.
   D. I wash my face.

16. What does the Arabic sentence يَدِي صَغِيرَةٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I clean my teeth.
   B. My hand is small.
   C. I wash my face.
   D. My head is big.

17. Which Arabic word means "beautiful"? (1 mark)
   A. رِيحٌ
   B. حَارٌّ
   C. جَمِيلٌ
   D. سَمَاءٌ

18. What does the Arabic sentence هَذِهِ شَمْسٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The sun is hot.
   B. The wind is strong.
   C. This is rain.
   D. This is the sun.

19. What does fii l-matbakhi taawila mean? (1 mark)
   A. In the kitchen there is a table.
   B. The table is small.
   C. I like the kitchen.
   D. The book is on the table.

20. Which Arabic sentence means "In the kitchen there is a table." (1 mark)
   A. فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ
   B. أُحِبُّ بَيْتِي
   C. هَذِهِ غُرْفَتِي
   D. فِي الْغُرْفَةِ سَرِيرٌ

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Translate into English: at-taawilatu Sagiira (2 marks)

22. Translate into English: al-kursiyyu jadiid (2 marks)

23. Translate into English: ʿindii hadiyya (2 marks)

24. Translate into English: fii l-matbakhi taawila (2 marks)

25. Translate into English: an-naafidhatu nadhiifa (2 marks)

26. Arrange these sentences into a good paragraph and give a reason: uhibbu baytii / haadhaa baytii / baytii kabiir. (3 marks) (3 marks)

27. Translate into English: al-asdiqaa'u ya'kuluuna l-kaʿka (2 marks)

28. Write أُمٌّ and جَدَّةٌ and give the meaning of each. (4 marks) (4 marks)

29. Translate into English: ash-shamsu haarra (2 marks)

30. Write one Arabic sentence about your body in sounds and translate it. (2 marks) (2 marks)

31. Translate into English: anaa uhibbu l-hafla (2 marks)

32. Translate into English: ummii tatbukhu T-taʿaam (2 marks)

33. A four-line poem says: ʿaynii taraa, udhunii tasmaʿu, anfii yashummu, famii yatakallamu. Give the meaning of the first line and say what the poem is about. (3 marks) (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #15 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — It shows where a letter joins to another
   The line is called a tatweel and shows joining.

2. A — thaa
   The letter ث is called thaa.

3. C — Most of the letters
   Most letters rest on the baseline. Alif stands tall above it.

4. B — ukht (sister)
   أُخْتٌ is ukht, sister.

5. B — son
   ابْنٌ (ibn) means son.

6. D — cupboard
   خِزَانَةٌ (khizaana) means cupboard.

7. C — The door is big.
   الْبَابُ كَبِيرٌ (al-baabu kabiir) means: The door is big.

8. D — The teacher says a word and you write it
   In a dictation you listen and write what you hear.

9. B — Tuesday
   الثُّلَاثَاءُ (ath-thulaathaa') means Tuesday.

10. B — juice
   عَصِيرٌ (ʿasiir) means juice.

11. B — I like the party.
   أَنَا أُحِبُّ الْحَفْلَةَ (anaa uhibbu l-hafla) means: I like the party.

12. A — I drink tea.
   أَشْرَبُ الشَّايَ (ashrabu sh-shaaya) means: I drink tea.

13. C — sugar
   سُكَّرٌ (sukkar) means sugar.

14. B — وَجْهٌ
   وَجْهٌ (wajh) means face.

15. D — I wash my face.
   aghsilu means I wash and wajhii means my face.

16. B — My hand is small.
   يَدِي صَغِيرَةٌ (yadii Sagiira) means: My hand is small.

17. C — جَمِيلٌ
   جَمِيلٌ (jamiil) means beautiful.

18. D — This is the sun.
   هَذِهِ شَمْسٌ (haadhihi shams) means: This is the sun.

19. A — In the kitchen there is a table.
   fii l-matbakhi means in the kitchen and taawila means a table.

20. A — فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ
   فِي الْمَطْبَخِ طَاوِلَةٌ (fii l-matbakhi taawila) means: In the kitchen there is a table.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: The table is small.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: The chair is new.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: I have a gift.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

24. (2 marks)
   Answer: In the kitchen there is a table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

25. (2 marks)
   Answer: The window is clean.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: haadhaa baytii. baytii kabiir. uhibbu baytii. The topic comes first, then a detail, then the feeling at the end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the first sentence, 1 mark for the order and 1 mark for the reason.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: The friends eat the cake.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

28. (4 marks)
   Answer: أُمٌّ (umm) means mother and جَدَّةٌ (jadda) means grandmother.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each neat correct word and 1 mark for each meaning.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: The sun is hot.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: For example aktubu bi-yadii. I write with my hand.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for a correct sentence and 1 mark for the translation.

31. (2 marks)
   Answer: I like the party.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: My mother cooks the food.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

33. (3 marks)
   Answer: My eye sees. The poem says what a part of the body does: the eye sees, the ear hears, the nose smells and the mouth speaks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning of the line and 2 marks for the poem's idea.
